    """
    A synthetic benchmark function designed to exhibit specific ELA features.

    f(x) = a * (x[0]^2 + x[1]^2) + b * sin(c * x[0] + d) + e * sin(f * x[1] + g) +

    a = 0.15 # Quadratic term

            h * x[0] * x[1] +

            j * x[1] +
